note: NL natural-wine restaurants: sommelier + socials, from Raisin venue list + web research (verified). Business/professional context only.

Owner Steven Macleod (with partner Eva Kolstee) drives the natural-wine focus and curates the list; he is not formally titled 'sommelier' but is the wine-responsible person. No separate house sommelier is publicly named for Alba itself (a separate venue Macleod co-opened in 2024 involves sommelier Mohamed Aous, but that is not Alba).

rows.name: BAK Restaurant

No individual sommelier/wine director is publicly named, so left empty. No Facebook page found.

Venue Instagram is @laak.bar ('Restaurant Bar Laak'). No sommelier or wine director is publicly named anywhere I could find, so left empty rather than guess. Raisin listed no website; a possible site laak.club could not be confirmed as the same venue.

sommeliers.name: Willem
sommeliers.role: Co-owner / wine-responsible (natural wine); full surname not published
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed: Willem is co-owner of Franco James (Nijmegen) alongside Luc, jointly responsible for the food and natural-wine program. Full surname not published. (francojames.bar, intonijmegen.com)

rows.notes: Nijmegen natural-wine bar (Priemstraat 9), listed on Raisin as natural wines. Owners Luc & Willem curate the natural wine program (only first names are published; no dedicated titled sommelier named). Wine list includes low-intervention/pet-nat and brut nature options.

rows.name: Gebr. Hartering

sommeliers.name: Niek Hartering
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed. The restaurant's own site and Gault&Millau describe Niek Hartering as running front-of-house and responsible for the (France-dominated, largely natural/organic) wine list, while brother Paul heads the kitchen.

sommeliers.name: Margot Los
sommeliers.verifyNote: Margot Los is Sommelier van het Jaar 2023 (Gault&Millau), but she is NOT associated with Gebr. Hartering. She is co-owner/sommelier of Café Parlotte in Amsterdam. The wine lead at Gebr. Hartering is Niek Hartering. This entry conflates two unrelated venues.

rows.notes: Amsterdam (Lastage). Eigenaar/chef Paul Hartering (Gault&Millau Vakman van het Jaar 2019); broer Niek Hartering doet bediening en stelde de wijnkaart samen. Sommelier Margot Los (Sommelier van het Jaar 2023) schenkt de bijzondere flessen. Wijnen doorgaans biologisch/biodynamisch, minimale interventie, soms echte vins nature. Namen geverifieerd via Proefschrift en Star Wine List.

rows.name: Gertrude
rows.notes: Amsterdam Oud-West (Bosboom Toussaintstraat). Chefs Amadou Dia and Billy Wattimena. Listed on iamsterdam's natural-wine restaurant guide; site and reviews reference 'a sommelier' and natural wines (e.g. PurJus by Ruhlmann-Dirring) but no individual sommelier / wine director is named, so sommeliers left empty. No own Facebook page found. Open daily.

rows.name: GIST

sommeliers.name: Lenore
sommeliers.role: Co-owner, responsible for the wine (natural wines) / front of house
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed. GIST is a bistro-restaurant at Langestraat 65, Tilburg (gisttilburg.nl), founded May 2023 by Lenore Inkelaar and chef Niek Gaertner. Lenore is co-owner/hostess responsible for hospitality and the (natural) wine list; Niek runs the open kitchen. Matches the stated role. Full name: Lenore Inkelaar. Sources: tilburg.com, missethoreca.nl, gisttilburg.nl/over-ons.

rows.notes: Bistro in Tilburg (Langestraat 65). Run by couple Lenore and Niek: Niek in the open kitchen, Lenore serves the natural wines (effectively the wijnverantwoordelijke). No surname is published and no formal 'sommelier' title is used, so only first name available. Explicitly natural-wine focused (also orange wine). Open. No sommelier corroborated beyond first name via press.

rows.name: Gitane
rows.notes: Restaurant in Amsterdam West opened July 2023 by chef Angelo Kremmydas (also of sister venue Massalia in Amsterdam Oost). Praised, Star Wine List 'White Star' wine list, mentioned in Michelin guide. Sister venue Massalia explicitly lists natural wines, but Gitane's own natural-wine stance is not explicitly stated, so marked unknown. No sommelier is publicly named (Kremmydas is the chef/owner).

rows.name: Héron Petit Restaurant

sommeliers.name: Victor
sommeliers.role: Mede-oprichter, verantwoordelijk voor wijnkennis/wijnselectie (geen formele sommelier-titel vermeld)
sommeliers.verifyNote: Victor Stukker, co-founder of Héron (Utrecht, opened 2016). The restaurant's own team page describes Victor as the founder with extensive wine knowledge (plus foraging). No formal sommelier title stated, consistent with the given role.

rows.notes: Utrecht. Eigen site noemt geen persoon met de titel 'sommelier'; mede-oprichter Victor wordt genoemd als degene met de wijnkennis/wijnselectie, Joyce doet de non-alcoholische pairings. Werkt expliciet met biologische, biodynamische en natuurwijn van kleine importeurs (o.a. Wijnen van 't Fort). Alleen voornamen gepubliceerd; achternaam niet vermeld.

rows.name: Hofaanzee
rows.notes: New Nordic-style restaurant in a historic farmhouse at the foot of the Dishoek dunes, Koudekerke (Zeeland); MICHELIN-listed. States it aims to serve wines as natural and pure as possible in line with its kitchen philosophy. No sommelier is publicly named, so the array is empty. Instagram @hofaanzee and Facebook hofaanzeedishoek confirmed.

rows.name: Hotel de Goudfazant
rows.notes: 100% natural since 2014; no individual sommelier named.

rows.name: Kaapse Maria
rows.notes: Weekly rotating natural-wine menu; wine advice by bar staff, no named sommelier.

rows.name: Kikkie van de Prinsensluis

sommeliers.name: Bram Kemme
sommeliers.verifyNote: His LinkedIn profile currently lists 'Assistent sommelier - Kikkie van de Prinsensluis' (Amsterdam wine-focused eetcafe), matching the stated role. Caveat: the only confirming source is his own self-reported LinkedIn; the venue site (kikkie.amsterdam) lists no staff names and there is no press corroboration. He also runs a wine business 'Kemme Wines', but LinkedIn shows the Kikkie role as current with no end date.

rows.notes: Eetcafe on a Jordaan canal corner, open daily. Explicitly features a curated selection of natural wines, many by the glass; listed on I amsterdam's natural-wine restaurants guide and on Raisin. Only publicly named wine-team member is Bram Kemme, who lists his role as 'Assistent sommelier' at Kikkie on LinkedIn; no head sommelier is publicly named.

rows.name: Klaproos
rows.notes: Wood-fired pizza and fresh-pasta spot at Papaverweg 39, Amsterdam-Noord (grew from a pop-up); short wine list with an emphasis on natural wines, featured in multiple Amsterdam natuurwijn guides and Gault&Millau. No sommelier or wine director is publicly named, so the array is empty. Instagram @klaproosamsterdam and Facebook klaproosamsterdam confirmed.

rows.name: Konijnenvoer
rows.notes: High-end plant-based/vegan restaurant in Arnhem (Italian classics with a plant-based twist), chef Demian Parasmo. Michelin- and Gault&Millau-listed. The site refers to 'onze sommelier' (our sommelier) who pairs each course, and the drinks include organic and orange wines, but the sommelier is not named publicly and natural wine is not explicitly stated (organic/orange only). Note: Misset Horeca reported the restaurant is relocating, so the address may change.

rows.name: La Maria
rows.notes: Owner-chef imports wines; only first name 'Rohan' on aggregators, unverified.

rows.name: Levain et le Vin

sommeliers.name: Judith ter Veld
sommeliers.role: Wine manager / wijnverantwoordelijke (managing the wine daily since summer 2022)
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed on the venue's own live About page (levainetlevin.com): 'Headbaker Jake Partridge and manager Laura van Rijs lead the team together, assisted by Judith ter Veld managing the wine, on a daily basis since summer 2022.' Levain et le Vin is an Amsterdam sourdough bakery + natural-wine shop/restaurant; Judith ter Veld is the day-to-day wine lead (WSET2/WSET3, ex-Bolomey Wijnimport). No formal 'sommelier' title is used, but the wine-manager/wijnverantwoordelijke role is confirmed. Site is live and the copy still reads as current.

rows.notes: Bakery/restaurant/wine venue founded by Florence Gramende and Constantijn. The venue website explicitly describes its wine program as natural wine (minimal intervention, little to no added sulphites) and names Judith ter Veld as running the wine since summer 2022. Corroboration limited to the venue's own site; role stated verbatim there. No Facebook page found.

rows.name: Little Collins West
rows.notes: Australian-inspired restaurant/bar in De Pijp, Amsterdam, listed among Amsterdam natural-wine venues (Raisin, iamsterdam). The De Pijp/West locations share the 'littlecollinsamsterdam' Instagram. No sommelier or wine director is publicly named.

rows.name: Local Dealer Food Inc
rows.notes: Family-owned Mexican taqueria in Amsterdam-Oost (Dapperplein 23). Offers a selection of natural wines alongside agave spirits (mezcal/tequila/sotol) and cocktails. No sommelier or wine director is publicly named, so sommeliers left empty.

rows.name: Locale Kaap
rows.notes: Owners Emmy Walburg and Rob Baris; they personally source biological/natural (vins naturels) wines from French producers. No individual publicly named as sommelier, so left empty.

rows.name: Lux
rows.notes: Chef-owner Milan Gataric (not sommelier).

rows.name: Massalia
rows.notes: French-Greek restobar at Beukenplein 21, Amsterdam-Oost (own site restobarmassalia.nl). Owner/chef Angelo Kremmydas (also owns Gitane). Reads as a natural-wine bar: list ranges from Jura/Burgundy classics to natural wines from Ikaria. No one is publicly named as sommelier/wine director, so the list is empty. Note: the source JSON had no website; the venue's actual site is https://www.restobarmassalia.nl/.

rows.name: Mecca
rows.notes: Rebranded: 'Mecca Oasis' in Rotterdam has become 'Oasis Rotterdam' (meccaoasis.nl now 301-redirects to oasisrotterdam.nl; the site states 'Born as Mecca Oasis... so did our name'). Petit grand cafe focused on specialty coffee and natural wine; Middle-Eastern/Mediterranean kitchen. Walk-in only. Chef Michalis Sofokleous mentioned in posts, but no sommelier/wine director is publicly named. Instagram moved from @meccaoasis to @oasis_rotterdam.

rows.name: Mevrouw Meijer
rows.notes: Cosy quasi-French restaurant in Rotterdam-Noord, taken over in 2018 by former employee Nils Wijnbergh (chef/owner); his wife Maria works as hostess. Serves a small wine list with per-course pairings but no sommelier or wine director is publicly named (Gault&Millau lists only Nils Wijnbergh as chef), so the array is left empty. No explicit natural-wine positioning found, hence 'unknown'. No Facebook page found.

rows.name: Multi Café
rows.notes: Lunch cafe & catering studio (Multi / Multi Multi) near Rotterdam Centraal, led by Laurence van Bergeijk and Lieke van der Wel; primarily a daytime lunch venue. Listed among Rotterdam's natural-wine venues on Raisin. No sommelier or wine director publicly named; owners are not identified as sommeliers.

rows.name: NAKED Amsterdam
rows.notes: Listed as restaurant/bar but is an espresso/coffee bar at Dam 8 (part of the Dam8 venue), emphasising award-winning baristas rather than a wine program. No sommelier or wine director; no natural-wine offering found. Possible mismatch with the festival's wine focus.

rows.name: Night Kitchen
rows.notes: Mediterranean neo-bistro & bar in Amsterdam Oud-West. Wine list is mostly organic with some natural wines, all from small producers; listed on Raisin as a natural-wine venue. No sommelier or wine director is publicly named on the site or in press.

rows.name: No Man’s Art Gallery & de bar
rows.notes: Amsterdam gallery bar. No sommelier or wine-responsible person publicly named (site lists only open kitchen/floor job postings). No explicit natural-wine claim found.

rows.name: Nomono
rows.notes: Restaurant & listening bar on Europalaan, Utrecht. Site states it closed as of 31 January 2026 after the head tenant terminated the lease (relocation being explored). Selection of natural and traditional wines. Founders Naresh Ramdjas and Johan Kuin; no sommelier publicly named.

rows.name: Ô bistro

sommeliers.name: Daniele
sommeliers.role: Host / sommelier (Italian; runs floor and wine service)
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed. Full name Daniele Gaudiello, Italian sommelier and co-owner of Ô Bistro (Lindengracht 248, Jordaan, Amsterdam), running the floor and wine service alongside French chef/co-owner Pierre Buffard. Confirmed by Star Wine List and multiple current venue writeups; venue is operating.

rows.notes: Small French bistro on Lindengracht 248, Jordaan. Run by French chef/owner Pierre and Italian host/sommelier Daniele, who curates the wine list. Listed on Star Wine List (a sommelier-focused wine-list directory). First name Daniele is corroborated across Star Wine List summary and a Dutch Culi Amsterdam feature; surname not reliably verifiable so only the first name is reported. No explicit natural-wine positioning found on the site.

rows.name: Oficina
rows.notes: Daily canteen, culinary studio and shop (Jan van Galenstraat 147, Amsterdam), guided by cooks and designers. Works explicitly with natural wine, listing producers such as Domaine Matassa, Jerome Saurigny, Jean-Pierre Robinot and Franz Strohmeier. No individual sommelier is publicly named; wine program is team-run.

rows.name: Olidò!
rows.notes: Wood-oven pizzeria in Amsterdam Oost, founded by Enrico Cantelmi and Tommaso Morelli (pizzaiolo) — owners, not sommeliers, so sommeliers left empty. Own site describes 'biologische wijnen' (organic); repeatedly listed in Amsterdam natural-wine roundups (De Buik, I amsterdam), hence naturalWine=yes.

rows.name: Onda

sommeliers.name: Juan Trentadue
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed current. Onda (Bierkade, Den Haag) is co-owned by Sanne Havinga, Juan Trentadue and Jelle Hamstra; Trentadue is co-owner/host and curated the wine list (all natural wine, largely own import from Argentina; he also runs Envido Imports). Onda won Best New Restobar 2025 at the Entree Awards and is active into 2026 (Gault&Millau listed). Sources: entreemagazine.nl/entreeawards/onda-in-den-haag-is-best-new-restobar-2025, denhaag.com/en/onda-kissa, gault-millau.nl/en/restaurants/onda-den-haag, LinkedIn juan-trentadue-97927325.

rows.notes: Restaurant & HiFi listening bar in The Hague (Best New Restobar 2025). Wine list is entirely natural wine, curated by co-owner/host Juan Trentadue; corroborated by Entree Magazine and Gault&Millau. Founded with Sanne Havinga and Jelle Hamstra (who also run nearby De Kade). Cocktails by Jonathan 'Jono' van Lamoen.

rows.name: OX
rows.notes: Underground/speakeasy-style contemporary Chinese restaurant and cocktail bar in central Rotterdam. Site states they work with small producers and natural wines; list of 50+ wines mixing classics and natural wines. Chef Alexander Wong leads the kitchen and Jacopo Di Domenico does cocktails, but no one is publicly named as sommelier/wine director, so the list is empty. No official Facebook page confirmed (the 'udesly' link on the site is the website builder, not the venue's page).

rows.name: Paindemie
rows.notes: Smash-burger/sando joint with speakeasy bar, Kinkerstraat 122, Amsterdam. Explicitly promotes 'NATURAL WINE' on its own site. Only first names Liva and Christina mentioned (front of house), no sommelier/wine director named, so sommeliers left empty.

rows.name: Parc Broekhuizen
rows.notes: Biodynamic + vins nature; venue copy uses 'schone en eerlijke wijnen'.

rows.name: Pianeta Terra

sommeliers.name: Laura Martini
sommeliers.role: Sommelier / wine list (co-owner, Fabio Antonini's partner)
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed current. Restaurant descriptions (heerlijk.nl, culi-amsterdam.nl, official pianetaterra-restaurant.nl) consistently list Laura Martini as sommelier and co-owner who compiles the entirely organic/biodynamic/natural Italian wine list, and as chef Fabio Antonini's partner. Pianeta Terra remains active (recently ranked best Italian restaurant in NL, 50 Top Italy).

rows.notes: Italian slow-food restaurant, Beulingstraat Amsterdam (ranked 50 Top Italy). Sommelier Laura Martini curates the wine list, selecting small producers 'with a soul'; corroborated by Culi Amsterdam and Italiamo/Foodies press. Wines are described as organic/small-producer but the venue does not explicitly brand itself as a natural-wine house, so naturalWine set to unknown. Chef/co-owner Fabio Antonini, manager Raul Mini.

rows.name: Piccolo Forno Vinz
rows.notes: Neapolitan sourdough pizzeria in Haarlem (Nassaustraat 24) pairing pizza with natural wines. Open Wed-Sat. No sommelier or wine-responsible person is publicly named on the site or in press, so sommeliers left empty (not invented).

rows.name: Pizza Lievito
rows.notes: Casual pizzeria in Monnickendam (Haringburgwal 1a) with thin crispy pizzas, weekly specials and an 'extensive wine selection' ('wijnen uit alle windstreken'). No explicit mention of natural wine and no sommelier named; it is a small owner-run pizza cafe.

rows.name: Pizzacafé DESEM
rows.notes: Pizza cafe in Nijmegen with a dedicated 'Natuurwijn' section on its site and natural-wine partners (2Naturkinder, Zuiver Wijnen, Bron Wines, producer Thomas Patek). A Facebook page named 'Pizza-café-DESEM' exists but I could not verify a clean canonical URL, so left null. No individual is publicly named as sommelier/wine director.

rows.name: Portfolio-Restaurant

sommeliers.name: Remco van Antwerpen
sommeliers.verifyNote: Gastheer/sommelier and co-founder of Portfolio (The Hague), partnership with chef Kasper Verlinden since 2017. Restaurant reopened at a new address (Dunne Bierkade 35) around April 2026 with the same team/formula. Confirmed current.

rows.notes: Den Haag, opgericht nov 2017 als samenwerking van chef Kasper Verlinden en sommelier Remco van Antwerpen. Site: 'Onze wijnen zijn over het algemeen natuurwijnen (vins naturelles)', plus biodynamisch en biologisch. Sommelier expliciet op eigen site vermeld.

rows.name: Puick
rows.notes: Family-run tasting-menu restaurant in Breda (started 2015). Site explicitly pours a selection of classic and natural wines ('klassieke en natuurwijnen'); a house sommelier presents the pairings but no individual sommelier is named publicly. No Michelin star.

rows.name: Putaine restaurant & bar

sommeliers.name: Jacqueline (Jacq) van 't Zelfde
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed as the sommelier responsible for Putaine's wine list. Entree Magazine and JAM Horeca coverage credit 'sommelier Jacqueline van 't Zelfde' with compiling the ~200-wine (largely biodynamic/natural) list; bartender Ben Lobos does cocktails. Owners are Eva Eekman and Michael Schook (same duo behind De Matroos en het Meisje and Heroine). Caveat: the most explicit 'sommelier' naming comes from opening/launch coverage (2022 JAM article) and the venue is now also branded 'Cafe Putaine'; the current site lists no staff roster, so I could not find a 2026-dated source re-confirming she is still in post. No evidence she has left. Sources: entreemagazine.nl, jamhoreca.nl, gault-millau.nl/en/restaurants/cafe-putaine-rotterdam.

rows.notes: Floating restaurant/bar in the Rijnhaven (FOR building), Kop van Zuid, Rotterdam; owners Eva Eekman & Michael Schook (also Heroine). Now also styled 'Cafe Putaine'. Wine list (~200 wines, mostly biodynamic, mix of conventional and natural) compiled by sommelier Jacqueline van 't Zelfde; corroborated by JAM! Horeca and Entree Magazine. Also collaborates with Rutger van de Pol (Bar Cult) for natural wines. JSON website field was null; live site is restaurantputaine.nl. Instagram handle inferred from site/brand, treat as best-effort.

rows.name: Restaurant Arles
rows.notes: 100% French list, monthly rotation, many naturals.

rows.name: Restaurant De Kade
rows.notes: Bistro at Dunne Bierkade 1A, The Hague; describes itself as the first 100% natural-wine restaurant in the city with one of the largest natural-wine selections (70+). No sommelier is publicly named by the venue; a single Tripadvisor review mentions a server 'Artie' recommending wines, which is not enough to confirm a named sommelier, so the array is left empty. Local/biodynamic small plates. Opened 2017 in the former 'Blij' location.

rows.name: Restaurant Entrepot

sommeliers.name: Jorrim Prins
sommeliers.verifyNote: Entrepot's own current wine page names Jorrim Prins (with Xander Waller) as composing the wine list; his LinkedIn lists Sommelier at Restaurant Entrepot. He is also associated with wine retailer Wijnkameel, but the venue site still credits him for wine, so role stands.

sommeliers.name: Xander Waller
sommeliers.verifyNote: Owner/maître of Restaurant Entrepot (Amsterdam, opened Nov 2017). Current venue wine page states Xander Waller and Jorrim Prins together curate the wine list. Confirmed.

rows.notes: Amsterdam, Entrepotdok 8. Van dezelfde ondernemers als Metro en Sandberg; eigenaar Xander Waller. Natuurwijn speelt een grote rol. Wijnpagina van de site vermeldt Xander Waller en Jorrim Prins als samenstellers van de wijnkaart (geen expliciete titel 'sommelier'). Geen officieel IG/FB via de site teruggevonden; niet ingevuld om verzinnen te voorkomen.

rows.name: Restaurant JA

sommeliers.name: Amy Delorme
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed by the venue's own 'Over ons' page and an Entree Magazine interview: Amy Delorme is gastvrouw and co-owner of Restaurant JA (De Pijp, Amsterdam), which she runs with chef/partner Julius Busscher with no other staff. She curated the wine list (natural + classic) and does the wine service/pairings, functioning as sommelier, though the venue text notes she is not 'formally titled' sommelier. Role 'Gastvrouw / sommelier' is accurate.

rows.notes: Intimate fine-dining home restaurant in De Pijp, Amsterdam, run by chef Julius Busscher and hostess Amy Delorme with no other staff. Amy Delorme handles service and the wine program as gastvrouw/sommelier, focusing on natural wine, classic wines and pairings. Listed on I amsterdam and De Buik van Amsterdam natural-wine guides.

rows.name: Restaurant ñ
rows.notes: Spanish tapas bar/restaurant, Nobelstraat 22, The Hague; Bib Gourmand (Michelin Guide NL 2025). Explicitly serves natural wines. Chef is Thomas Vandenhecke, but no dedicated sommelier/wine director is publicly named, so sommeliers left empty. IG @restobar_n; no venue Facebook page found.

rows.name: Restaurant Renilde

sommeliers.name: Sjanne Vlug
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed and current: Sjanne Vlug (ex-Fermin) is sommelier at Renilde (rooftop of Depot Boijmans, Rotterdam), managing the natural-wine list. Named as Renilde's sommelier in a 2026 ProefCast Wine Professional session with chef Jim de Jong. (debuik.nl, proefschrift.nl 2026)

sommeliers.name: Jim de Jong
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed: Jim de Jong (ex-Restaurant De Jong, Gault Millau Young Top Chef 2019) is chef/owner of Renilde, creating a daily-changing menu. Still active per 2026 sources. (debuik.nl, wijnspijs.nl, dehavenloods.nl)

rows.notes: Rooftop restaurant on Depot Boijmans Van Beuningen, Rotterdam. Sommelier Sjanne Vlug manages an adventurous wine list with many natural wines from independent winemakers (corroborated by Wijnspijs and Wine Professional 2026, where the Renilde team paired natural wines). Chef Jim de Jong. Runs under Boijmans; no separate venue Instagram/Facebook identified.

rows.name: Restaurant Rotonde

sommeliers.name: Birk Heijkants
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed on the live Rotonde site (restaurantrotonde.nl), which lists Birk Heijkants on the team as the wine/hospitality lead running its natural-wine-only program; he is also a co-founder (with chef Jord Coree and Roy Lammers, opened Dec 2021). Corroborated by De Buik 'Proef op de sommelier' feature and 360 Eat Guide.

rows.notes: Rotterdam. Michelin Bib Gourmand + Green Star, tagline 'Seizoensgroenten, vuur & natuurwijn'. Sommelier Birk Heijkants (former food/drink journalist) runs a strictly natural-wine, no-additives, Europe-only program; corroborated by the venue site, De Buik ('Proef op de sommelier met Birk Heijkants') and 360 Eat Guide. Team also: chef Jord Coree, host Roy Lammers. Open Tue-Sat.

rows.name: Restaurant Tres

sommeliers.name: Emy Koster
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed as sommelier/head sommelier, hostess and co-owner of Tres (Rotterdam), alongside chef Michael van der Kroft, per De Buik van Rotterdam, Gault&Millau and Falstaff. Self-taught sommelier; venue active (Green Michelin Star 2025).

rows.notes: 16-seat tasting-menu restaurant at Kop van Zuid, Rotterdam. Co-owners Emy Koster and Michael van der Kroft; Emy Koster is the sommelier (profiled in De Buik 'De Proef op de Sommelier'). Wine program favours organic/biodynamic and natural wines. ~95% of guests take the pairing.

rows.name: Restobar Rosie

sommeliers.name: Yora Galjaard
sommeliers.role: Gastheer / verantwoordelijk voor wijnselectie (not formally titled sommelier)
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed as co-owner and host of Restobar Rosie (Utrecht) responsible for the wine selection (~200 wines by the glass), per De RestaurantKrant and dining guides. Not formally titled sommelier, matching the stated role. Still active; he and Jac Rijks opened a second venue.

rows.notes: Utrecht eatbar. Chef Jac Rijks; host Yora Galjaard leads wine buying trips with importer Pieksman Wijnimport and works with natural-wine producers. No one is formally titled 'sommelier'; Galjaard is the wine lead. Facebook not confirmed.

rows.name: Rijsel

sommeliers.name: Eelke Leeuwerink
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed current. Rijsel's own website (rijsel.com/en) names Eelke Leeuwerink as sommelier alongside owners Pieter Smits & Stephanie Lucken, chef Iwan Driessen and maitre Merel Schenkeveld. A Dec 2025 press item (Girls Who Magazine) shows him curating wine pairings for a Dec 13 2025 dinner, so the role is current.

rows.notes: French bistro in a former school (Amsterdam Oost). Sommelier Eelke Leeuwerink confirmed on the venue site and corroborated by Gault&Millau and lekker.nl (which has a dedicated 'sommelier Eelke Leeuwerink' person page). Wine list is French-led (with German/Italian), 25+ by the glass; no explicit natural-wine positioning found, so naturalWine is unknown. No own Instagram found on the site.

rows.name: Ristorante La Scala
rows.notes: Italian restaurant in Amersfoort since 1986. Works with biological and natural wines from small producers, partly via their own import 'Troppo Giovane'. No sommelier is publicly named by title; a hostess named 'Tosca' is praised in reviews for wine recommendations but is not identified as a titled sommelier, so sommeliers left empty. Site (WebFetch) did not list staff; corroborated via Raisin and eet.nu.

rows.name: SAAR

sommeliers.name: Sandra
sommeliers.role: Co-owner; selects and pours the natural wines (wijnverantwoordelijke). No formal 'sommelier' title published.
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed current. SAAR is a natural-wine cafe-restaurant in Utrecht (Catharijnesingel), co-owned by Sandra and Ramon (partner Ramon cooks; Sandra runs front-of-house). The live site lists Sandra first among those who 'serve the wines' and the venue is built around vin nature / biodynamic and natural wines, matching the 'co-owner, wijnverantwoordelijke, no formal sommelier title' description. Note: venue is in Utrecht, not Amsterdam. Sources: en.saar-utrecht.nl, duic.nl, exploreutrecht.nl.

rows.notes: Cafe-restaurant on Catharijnesingel, Utrecht (since 2018). Explicitly a natural-wine venue ('GOOD FOOD & NATURAL WINES', love for 'onbewerkte, wilde wijnen'; suppliers Vinatura, Wilde Wijnen, Clavelin, Zuiver wijnen). Owners are Sandra and Ramon; Sandra handles the wine. No named chef-sommelier; wine service is shared across the floor team, so I did not assert a formal sommelier beyond Sandra as the wine-responsible co-owner.

rows.name: Satiata
rows.notes: Restaurant, bar and adjoining natural-wine shop (Satiata Wine & Liquor, @satiatastore) at Piushaven 5, Tilburg. Run by two hosts named Mattijs and Midas, who personally handle the wine and pairings; no one is publicly titled 'sommelier'/'wine director', so the sommelier list is left empty. Explicitly a natural-wine venue.

rows.name: Schout bij nacht
rows.notes: Restaurant & bar in the Jordaan (Westerstraat 76-78), opened end of May 2025; becomes a music/vinyl bar in the evening. Wine list explicitly features natural and biodynamic wines, mostly Old World. No individual sommelier/wine director publicly named.

rows.name: Sec Marché

sommeliers.name: Freek Kattenberg
sommeliers.verifyNote: Company.info / KVK registration (86251112) for Sec Marché in Hattem lists 'Kattenberg, F.' as management since 2022. Press (Drimble/Trouw, 2022) describes Freek Kattenberg (then 24, from Zwolle) as the founder and natural-wine specialist who opened Sec's natural-wine shop in Hattem, matching the 'Eigenaar / wijnverantwoordelijke (natuurwijn-specialist)' role. Note: Sec Marché is based in Hattem (Ridderstraat 13), not Amsterdam, though partner/pour-out venues exist in Amsterdam. No source found indicating he has left; the strongest corroboration (KVK listing) is undated as to present status, so treat as current-but-not-freshly-reconfirmed.

rows.notes: Natural-wine shop with tasting cellar at Ridderstraat 13, Hattem (300+ wines, focus on natural wine, plus cheese/charcuterie). Owner Freek Kattenberg curates and presents the wines — corroborated by a Drimble/regional news feature and the Sec Wines site. Original listed domain sec-utrecht.nl is now a casino/parked site; the live domain is secwines.nl (contact marche@secwines.nl), so status flagged as rebranded/domain-changed. No verified venue-specific Instagram/Facebook found (left null).

rows.name: September
rows.notes: Amsterdam venue: small owner-run winebar/restaurant at Baffinstraat 1 (De Baarsjes), in the former Wijnhuis Somm building. Run by three friends Matthew, Lizzy and Valentijn; seasonal French-influenced menu, ~1/3 of wines natural, biodynamic produce. IG bio: 'big plates, small menu & (natural) wines'. No named sommelier (owner-run), so sommeliers left empty. No own Facebook page found. (This is the Amsterdam September, distinct from September in The Hague.)

rows.name: September
rows.notes: Wine, Jazz & Food bar on the Grote Markt, The Hague; wine list of 100+ wines, tapas by chefs Dave & Bobby, weekly live jazz. No sommelier or wine buyer is publicly named. No explicit natural-wine statement found on the reachable pages (wine-list page not accessible).

rows.name: SILK
rows.notes: Modern Asian restaurant & bar in Amsterdam Oud-West (Bilderdijkstraat) serving natural wines and cocktails. From Limau Chen and Paolo Manzo (Salvo Bakehouse). No dedicated sommelier/wine director publicly named, so left empty.

rows.name: Sip First
rows.notes: Breda brewbar & kitchen (St. Janstraat 24), primarily a specialty-coffee/brunch venue; Raisin lists a selection of natural wines. Owned by Teun and Inge Fransen (owners, not described as sommeliers), so no sommelier named. Second Instagram @sip.firstfloor is an events space.

rows.name: Skatecafe
rows.notes: Amsterdam-Noord bistro/bar with skate ramp, run by Karin & Yvonne. Serves seasonal food and natural/organic wines (listed among Amsterdam natural-wine spots). No sommelier or wine director is publicly named on the site or in press; owners Karin & Yvonne are named but not as sommeliers, so sommeliers left empty rather than invented.

rows.name: Stiel

sommeliers.name: Wendy Persoon
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed as sommelier/gastvrouw and co-owner of Stiel (Rotterdam), alongside chef/co-owner Mattia Sabino Caso; formerly sommelier at Restaurant Renilde. Venue is active but currently renovating/moving to a new location in Crooswijk (with a temporary Oogstmarkt presence on Saturdays from Aug 1), so the physical restaurant is in transition though her role stands.

rows.notes: Rotterdam restaurant (Station Bergweg) opened by chef Mattia Caso and sommelier/restaurant manager Wendy Persoon; she selects the wines (mainly Germany/France, small responsible producers), natural and artisanal. Wendy Persoon is former sommelier/manager of Restaurant Renilde. JSON had website:null; actual site is https://stielrestaurant.nl/. No Facebook found.

rows.name: TestTafel
rows.notes: Amsterdam restaurant; own website offers 'low-intervention and natural wines' as pairings. No sommelier or wine director named on the site, Instagram bio, or press, so left empty. No Facebook page found; also on TikTok @desering.testtafel.

rows.name: The Green Rose

sommeliers.name: Jin Hu
sommeliers.role: Chef-owner; started his career as a sommelier and curates the wine program (biodynamic and natural wines).
sommeliers.verifyNote: Confirmed current. Jin Hu is chef-owner of The Green Rose in Arnhem (still operating, on 2026 Michelin/Gault&Millau guides; site shows 'HOME 2026'). Multiple sources (Misset Horeca opening piece, Wijnspijs) state he began his career as a sommelier and prioritises fine/natural and biodynamic wines on the menu, so he curates the wine program. Sources: thegreenrose.nl, missethoreca.nl, wijnspijs.nl, guide.michelin.com.

rows.notes: Cafe-bistro on Koningstraat, Arnhem, opened by Jin Hu (2018). Multiple sources note Jin Hu began as a sommelier before cooking; the wine program features classic, organic, biodynamic and natural wines (including some without sulfites). No separate named sommelier; the wine responsibility sits with chef-owner Jin Hu.

rows.name: The Meets
rows.notes: Vegetarian/vegan Italian-influenced restaurant in Amsterdam's Indische Buurt (Javastraat). Works with natural wines (confirmed via Star Wine List and venue IG). No sommelier or wine director publicly named, so sommeliers left empty.

rows.name: Turbo Amsterdam

sommeliers.name: Thiago De Sena
sommeliers.role: Sommelier / co-owner (wine curation) — single-source, treat as unconfirmed
sommeliers.verifyNote: Could not confirm Thiago De Sena as sommelier/co-owner at Turbo specifically. A local source (oosterpark.nl) identifies him as sommelier AND co-owner of De Tros, the sister venue — but the same source lists Bar Turbo's owners as Floris Baltes, Pierre de Wit, Henty van Holthe, Mats van der Sluijs and Bart Hendriks, WITHOUT Thiago De Sena. Turbo's own website (turboamsterdam.nl) names no sommelier or wine curator at all. His confirmed role is at De Tros, not Turbo. No confirmed current Turbo sommelier found. Note: Turbo and De Tros share ownership but the Turbo-specific wine attribution to De Sena is unverified (matches the single-source caveat in the input).

rows.notes: Coffee spot / snack bar serving brunch, dinner, specialty coffee and natural wine (stated on own site) at Reinwardtstraat 1, Amsterdam Oost. From the Café de Tros team (Floris Baltes and co-owners). One source (Oosterpark BIZ article) names Thiago De Sena as sommelier and co-owner curating the wine list; only a single source, so treat as unconfirmed. No Facebook page found.

rows.name: V&A Bar Bistro
rows.notes: French bistro in the Jordaan (Prinsengracht 274), formerly 'Venus & Adonis'; venusenadonis.nl now redirects to vabarbistro.nl. Owner is Joyce Lieven. 80+ wine list with natural wines from their 'Vleck' collection. A Tripadvisor review names a 'Tim' as sommelier, but this is not corroborated by the venue or a second source, so sommeliers left empty. IG @vabarbistro; no venue Facebook page confirmed.

rows.name: Vert restaurant
rows.notes: Middelburg. Run by owners Richard & Julia. Wines are biodynamic/naturally made (unfiltered, natural fermentation, no additives). Sommelier advice/wine pairings offered but no individual sommelier is publicly named, so left empty rather than invent one.

rows.name: Villa Augustus
rows.notes: Hotel and garden-to-table restaurant in a former water tower, Dordrecht. No sommelier or wine-director is publicly named. Wine list is modest and by-the-glass; some natural wines appear (white/orange from Vignoble Klur, Alsace) but there is no explicit natural-wine positioning, so naturalWine set to unknown. Site returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch; findings from web search and Facebook.

rows.name: VRR
rows.notes: Amsterdam-Oost (Conradstraat). Bakery-by-day / restaurant-by-dinner concept (VRR = 'Voorheen Rosa en Rita'), owned by Sander Overeinder. Wine program is explicitly 'biodynamisch en vooral natuurwijnen' from France, Italy and Germany, with a self-serve wine room. No sommelier / wine director is publicly named on the site or in press, so sommeliers left empty. Open for dinner Tue-Sat from 18:00.

rows.name: Zomer loket
rows.notes: Seasonal natural-wine pop-up bar run by Amsterdam natural-wine importer/collective Sebonsa (@sebonsa.ams), relocated in May 2025 to the Marineterrein (near Scheepskameel). It is a bar rather than a full restaurant, so no individual sommelier/wine director is publicly named; the wine program is curated by Sebonsa. Explicitly a natural-wine venue. Note it operates seasonally (roughly Thu-Sun in summer).
